summary: Verified new RETRATO (character portrait image) field in SheetPositionEditor and InteractiveCharacterSheet. All acceptance criteria met.

loadFromFile branch in editor does not preserve height/multiline fields on JSON import — inconsistent with DB load. Non-blocking.
